title: On-Device Named-Entity Recognition: A Deployability Study of Accuracy, Cost, Reliability, and Confidence
abstract: arXiv:2610.00007v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Named-entity recognition (NER) is increasingly wanted on-device (no API, low latency, data kept local). The practitioner's question is not the leaderboard but which model is deployable, how to evaluate it without human annotation, and whether its confidence can be trusted. We answer these jointly. We place nine systems across three paradigms and 13 M to 8 B parameters: a classical tagger (spaCy), bidirectional-encoder specialists (GLiNER, 166 to 460 M), and generative LLMs run locally (Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B/4B-Instruct, DeepSeek-R1-1.5B/8B), on three datasets of differing character, and report accuracy plus two axes the literature omits: latency and output validity. Because our corpus (RSS-News) had no gold, we built silver gold from a cross-family LLM judge panel, then measured its fidelity against benchmark gold and a full human re-validation of the corpus (strict F1 0.95, an upper bound since the human gold was silver-seeded); gold proven

translated_title: 设备端命名实体识别：关于准确性、成本、可靠性与置信度的可部署性研究
translated_abstract: 命名实体识别（NER）在设备端（无需API、低延迟、数据保存在本地）的需求日益增长。从业者关心的问题并非排行榜，而是哪个模型是可部署的、如何在没有人工标注的情况下评估它，以及它的置信度是否可信。我们对这些问题进行了联合解答。我们比较了横跨三种范式、参数量从1300万到80亿的九个系统：经典标注器、双向编码器专家模型（GLiNER，1.66亿至4.6亿参数），以及本地运行的生成式大语言模型（Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B/4B-Instruct、DeepSeek-R1-1.5B/8B），在三个不同特点的数据集上进行测试，并报告了准确率以及文献中常被忽略的两个维度：延迟和输出有效性。由于我们的语料库（RSS-News）没有金标准，我们通过跨家族的大语言模型评审小组构建了银标准，然后对照基准金标准以及对语料库的完整人工复验（严格F1为0.95，这是一个上限值，因为人工金标准本身是以银标准为种子构建的）来衡量其保真度；金标准的来源……
tldr: 该研究通过对比九种不同范式的设备端NER系统，提出利用跨家族LLM评审小组构建银标准语料以实现无人工标注的评估方法，并将延迟和输出有效性纳入准确率之外的可部署性评估维度。
en_tdlr: This study compares nine on-device NER systems across three paradigms, proposes building silver-gold annotations via a cross-family LLM judge panel to enable evaluation without human labeling, and extends deployability assessment beyond accuracy to include latency and output validity.
